name: bus-kar
description: Real-time Indian city bus telemetry (DTC/DIMTS Delhi, BMTC Bengaluru, BEST Mumbai), live GPS ETAs, crowd occupancy, route planning, Pink Ticket fare calculator, and colloquial station tag resolution.

bus-kar.description: Bus Kar! Live Transit & Telemetry Engine

tools.name: resolve_stop
tools.description: Resolves colloquial Indian bus stop nicknames or landmarks (e.g. Purana Adda, Silk Board, AIIMS gate 2) into official GTFS stop IDs.

tools.name: get_live_bus_eta
tools.description: Retrieves real-time bus arrivals and live GPS telemetry at a stop, including countdown, crowd occupancy, and live map link.

tools.name: plan_transit_trip
tools.description: Plans a point-to-point transit journey calculating routes, travel time, fare estimate, and first/last-mile ride suggestions.

tools.name: get_fare_and_ticketing_info
tools.description: Calculates official bus fares, checks concession eligibility (e.g. Delhi Pink Pass 100% free for women), and returns ticketing links.

tools.name: suggest_colloquial_tag
tools.description: Registers a new public colloquial nickname for a bus stop.

tools.name: vote_stop_tag
tools.description: Upvotes or downvotes an existing crowdsourced colloquial stop tag.

tools.name: list_stop_tags
tools.description: Lists all active public colloquial aliases for a stop.
